I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The source is the incident channel itself, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 the same day she posted that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I also told him that the channel doesn't give a street address for Southgate, and that the shared files have no Tansley account folder. If he needs the address, someone on the account will have to supply it.
